description_en: Lists the logs for a data source
description_zh: 查看数据源下的日志列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-data-source-logs --data-source-instance-id 220ba97c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca328d7ea --account-id 123xxxxxx --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataSourceLogs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source. This ID is an MD5 hash value that is calculated by threat analysis based on specific parameters
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成
parameters.name: data_source_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The code for the cloud service provider. Valid values:

qcloud: Tencent Cloud.

aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.

hcloud: Huawei Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
多云的code。取值：
qcloud：腾讯云。
aliyun：阿里云。
hcloud：华为云
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management hub of threat analysis is deployed. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
